scope: Bounded native offline Docker timing probe; static review only, not full CLI or packaged Main acceptance

issues.finding: Request file is absent at the supplied path at review completion. No exact requested argv, source/binary digests or execution binding can be accepted.
issues.fix: Publish the actual request with pinned probe/guard/relay/Docker/source identities and intended exact invocation; reviewer will compare against these script hashes.

issues.finding: Cleanup aborts on its first inspect/assert/removal failure, leaving later owned containers/volumes unattempted and omitting completion.json. A failed relay read/result also leaves the spawned guard process without an explicit terminate/wait in finally.
issues.fix: Keep the primary result and per-resource cleanup errors separately; attempt every exact owned resource independently; always write a terminal receipt and reap the owned child with a bounded wait. Cleanup failure must keep acceptance false.

issues.finding: Resource IDs/names enter the ledger only after create returns success. If Docker creates a container or volume but the CLI times out or returns an ambiguous failure, finally only iterates the prior ledger and can miss that new resource.
issues.fix: Persist the exact name/owner/create intent before mutation. On a failed create, boundedly inspect that exact name and accept ownership only if label/image/identity match, then retain it for cleanup. Never broadly remove resources by name prefix.

verified_static_properties: Timing probe fixes the old CLI image to sha256:8d5ede4df2fa4b66d499803b95428b729fcb6ba753b3800e9b931b968ee16104 and checks v0.6.7 plus commit9caea35808afc8d05fb6135bfc74d4bfb0b45cf1.

Guard exact argv matching preserves network-none/read-only/linux-amd64; actual relay execution also retains cap-drop ALL/no-new-privileges/bounded tmpfs/readonly relay volume. No privileged/unconfined flag is admitted.
Stage container is created for copy and never started; version uses the existing canonical version-check policy.
Normal post-create container operations resolve recorded64hex IDs and inspect label/image/name/network/read-only state; volume removal verifies owner label.
Only a synthetic token and synthetic409 reply enter the relay; this probe does not call the product API or prove the ten-operation business journey.
additional_boundary_note: timing_probe.py:16 sets DOCKER_CONFIG to the personal Docker config directory. The concrete request should identify the intended local Docker endpoint; current command construction does not pin context/daemon. Prefer an explicit known local endpoint and a task-owned minimal config to avoid default-context drift. No personal Docker config was read by reviewer.
